snippet.title: Gears of War 3 PC Delta Online Fan Made Project Unofficial Trailer!
snippet.description:
Gears of War 3 PC Delta Online Fan Made Project Unofficial Trailer!

●Support me further by becoming a Youtube Channel Member Shadow Knight here & Get Exclusive Early Access to watch all these Videos First!: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC0XhmncojSLo-4oCqD-8wpA/join

Welcome back to another Gears of War 3 Video! Today we are going to be sharing the Gears of War 3 PC Delta Online fan made project unofficial trailer on behalf of the Gears of War PC community highlighting the Gears of War 3 PC Delta Online versus multiplayer all maps & modes, Gears of War 3 PC Delta Online horde mode all maps & modes, to the Gears of War 3 PC Delta Online all characters skins unlockables & so much more!

Warning Disclaimer this video is made for entertainment documentary purposes only, this is not an actual remaster, this is an unofficial fan made project version that is not endorsed by or affiliated with either Epic Games, The Coalition Studio or Microsoft who own the IP rights. There is no download link available.

•Twitch: http://www.twitch.tv/sasxsh4dowz
•Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@sasxsh4dowz
•Kick: https://kick.com/sasxsh4dowz
•Twitter: https://twitter.com/SASxSH4DOWZ
•Shadowz Discord: https://discord.gg/YDfAdhv
•Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sasxshadowz
•Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SASxSH4DOWZ
